lines.text: Crypto culture lives on charts. It has nowhere to play.
Games with real stakes still start with seed phrases, faucets and wallet popups, and they put only the final result on chain.
Mempire turns the market into a game. Every coin, memecoin and stock is a fighter, and today's price moves buff or nerf it.
Two players stake a dollar, play a three-minute battle, and every card they drop is a Monad transaction.
Why now, and why Monad? Blocks voted in three hundred milliseconds and final in under a second make a transaction per card possible for the first time, and cheap gas keeps it free to feel.

It is live on Monad testnet: eight verified contracts, passkey onboarding in about ten seconds, staked matches settled on chain, a Chainlink-written market meta, Pyth-priced mints, and gasless chests through EIP-7702.
Next: mainnet, dollar stakes in AUSD, and clan wars as the social layer, where every community fights for its coin.
Mempire. Every coin is a fighter.
